Doon Institute of Management & Technology vs LIBRA College of Law is a Dehradun LLM comparison with very thin data. One side has no fee row, and neither college has a placement or rank.

sections.heading: Doon Uttarakhand vs LIBRA College Of Law for LLM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Doon Institute of Management & Technology if you want the recorded LLM year tuition of ₹60,000, after you confirm the official notice, and after you ignore the ₹5,000 registration row as a programme fee.
Choose LIBRA College of Law only after you have an official fee circular, because our table lists an LL.M. programme but has no fee, placement or rank row.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Doon Institute we hold year tuition of ₹60,000 for Master of Law (LLM), plus a separate ₹5,000 registration-fee year row. Do not quote the registration fee as the LLM fee.
For LIBRA College of Law we hold no fee row on this page. Do not invent an LLM fee.
Confirm the current notices on the official Doon Institute and LIBRA College pages before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Neither college has a placement row on this page for LLM.
Ask both campuses for an official internship or placement note if outcomes are central to your decision.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each college's official LLM admissions process.
Our table has no ranking rows for either college in this comparison.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, as private institutions, so a local student can visit them on the same day.
With so little table data, a campus visit and the official prospectus matter more than the empty rows.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Doon Institute if the recorded ₹60,000 year tuition and that campus fit you, after official confirmation.
Pick LIBRA College of Law only if that campus is the offer you want, after you have a written official fee.
This page has no placement or rank data to break the tie.

faqs.question: What LLM fees are on record?
faqs.answer: Doon Institute has year tuition of ₹60,000, plus a ₹5,000 registration-fee row that is not the programme fee. LIBRA College of Law has no fee row on this page. Confirm official notices.

faqs.question: Are placement figures available?
faqs.answer: No. Neither college has a placement row on this page for LLM. Ask both campuses for an official note.

faqs.question: Is an entrance exam listed?
faqs.answer: No exam is mapped on this page. Follow each college's official LLM admissions process.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Dehradun?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, as private institutions.

faqs.question: Do they have ranks on this page?
faqs.answer: No. Our table has no ranking rows for either college in this comparison.

faqs.question: Should I treat the ₹5,000 row as the LLM fee?
faqs.answer: No. That figure is a registration-fee year row at Doon Institute. The recorded tuition is ₹60,000 a year.
